summary: G1 and G5 PASS. G2, G3, G4 are PARTIAL pending CI Postgres execution, project owner human sign-off, and external open-source chatbot hosting.

G1_Lab_Core.name: Gate 1: Lab Core
G1_Lab_Core.blueprint_description: Foundational trace engine, claim verification, and can-fail benchmark evaluation.
pass_conditions: 1. Full trace engine schema validation.
2. Claim-vs-State verifier detects failure modes with strict verdict equality on planted bugs (100.0% recall, 0.0% clean FPR, 6x6 confusion matrix).
3. Frozen SEALED benchmark dataset evaluated with negative controls: accuracy 80.0%, precision 100.0%, clean FPR 0.0%.

G2_Watchdog_and_Security.name: Gate 2: Watchdog & Security
G2_Watchdog_and_Security.blueprint_description: Tenant isolation, PII/DLP protection, and post-execution data integrity rules.
pass_conditions: 1. Structural tenant isolation across all tenant tables via TenantScopedSession and get_tenant_db.
2. Route dependency test proving no tenant endpoint depends on unscoped get_db.
3. Watchdog engine detects data faults and integration discrepancies.
4. Live PostgreSQL RLS cross-tenant proof.
missing_items: Live PostgreSQL 16 RLS execution (runs in CI container job via .github/workflows/ci.yml; local dev environment is SQLite)

G3_Scout_Safety.name: Gate 3: Scout Safety
G3_Scout_Safety.blueprint_description: Permission-first black-box auditing safeguards and execution control.
pass_conditions: 1. Signed scope.yaml with validity time window and explicit allowed host allowlist.
2. Runtime egress refusal blocks unapproved out-of-scope targets (0 network calls).
3. Emergency kill switch halts outbound requests across 4 mechanisms in < 5.0 seconds (measured median 34.4ms, max 58.4ms).
4. Human review gate strictly prevents self-approval and rejects placeholder reviewers.
missing_items: Manual reviewer sign-off from project owner with authenticated identity (scout intentionally refused self-approval)

G4_Real_World.name: Gate 4: Real-World Readiness
G4_Real_World.blueprint_description: Real runtime model comparisons, target chatbot audit, and architectural boundary isolation.
pass_conditions: 1. Target adapters execute against test chatbot with egress refusal.
2. T0 internal sandbox audit on ShopOps bot with confidence labels and reproducibility.
3. End-to-end T1 audit on separate self-hosted open-source chatbot.
4. Multi-model evaluation comparing real model vs mock baseline.
missing_items: T1 audit against separate open-source chatbot (marked NOT DONE: secondary chatbot not self-hosted on this host)

G5_Launch.name: Gate 5: Launch & CI Reliability
G5_Launch.blueprint_description: Automated regression CI, single-command verification, and launch demo assets.
pass_conditions: 1. Automated CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) with pinned actions and Postgres RLS job.
2. Reusable GitHub Action for regression gating (.github/actions/argvtix-gate/action.yml).
3. Planted regression test suite proving CI rejects 6 real regressions and passes clean candidate.
4. README badge dynamically validated against collected pytest count.
5. 2-minute demo script and architecture documentation.
